##### Project general facts

Soho Square is a medium-rise, mixed-use urban development that encompasses commercial, retail, and residential elements, embracing the focus of the surrounding landscape by attracting a sense of openness and transparency into its core design. This uniquely crafted development features a central courtyard that elevates the vital sense of local community and public connectivity, interlinking two residential blocks. Inspired by the SoHo district of New York, this project aims to redefine the definition of urban living with a space filled with tasteful art, choice gourmet brands, and trendy cafes.

The residential complex features high-end residences ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments, townhouses, and penthouses, all built on the notions of sustainable and vibrant living environments. Residents can experience a modern and vibrant living experience with spaces that encourage conversations and new perspectives on the living experience. Those who love art, music, and global vibes will feel right at home in this modern-day sanctuary from the mundane.

The interiors have been created keeping the global citizen in mind, with contemporary yet minimalistic styling that accentuates bright open living spaces. The simple lines and design philosophy are inspired by classic loft apartments of the SoHo district that are artistic yet trendy, creating a harmonious blend of style and functionality. Equipped kitchens ensure effortless culinary experiences, while every detail has been carefully considered to create a bold new lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated on Saadiyat Island, a thoughtfully curated community that embodies the pursuit of cultural enrichment, luxurious living, and natural beauty. This prestigious destination is designed to harmonize residential, cultural, and recreational elements, creating a vibrant and interconnected community that celebrates the finer aspects of life. The island is home to world-renowned cultural institutions like the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, making it a hub for artistic expression, education, and inspiration.

Residents have unparalleled access to cultural experiences, fostering a sense of intellectual and creative engagement that elevates the community's character. The island's natural beauty plays a significant role in shaping the community's identity, with pristine beaches, lush parks, and serene waterfront views offering a tranquil escape from the bustling city. The integration of nature into the community design encourages a balanced and healthful way of life.

The location in the university neighborhood provides a dynamic and intellectually stimulating environment, with transportation facilities around the corner. All the excitement of the island is on the doorstep, and downtown Abu Dhabi is just moments away. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of cultural richness, natural beauty, and urban accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Abu Dhabi's most prestigious destinations.
